key_insight: High-fidelity wall-resolved iLES can generate a realistic free-stream transition database that exposes major weaknesses in standard RANS transition models.
engineering_relevance: This dataset provides the detailed 3D, time-resolved boundary-layer data needed to improve transition prediction for aerodynamic and turbomachinery design.
method: Wall-resolved implicit LES of bypass transition over a flat plate
Multiple freestream turbulence levels with zero and varying pressure gradients
Comparison against ERCOFTAC T3-style experiments and RANS models (SA-BCM, k-ω-γ)
evidence_signal: The simulations match legacy experimental trends for skin friction, mean velocity, and fluctuation profiles, while RANS models show systematic errors in transition onset and length.
watch_item: The database is highly valuable, but it remains tied to a specific flat-plate bypass-transition setting, so care is needed when generalizing to other geometries or transition mechanisms.
paper_title: A high-fidelity numerical database for free-stream transition
